data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2022 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (prior year comparative) was GBP 740.162m. During 2022 the Syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 194.595m (approximately 26.3% of opening reserves), driven by reassessments of prior years' claims including geopolitical exposures (notably Russia/Ukraine), prior COVID-19 related loss strengthening in reinsurance lines and additional IBNR for inflationary pressures. The movement is reflected across property/energy exposures and the Syndicate's reinsurance acceptances.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and prior-year movement taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) and Technical Provisions reconciliation table respectively (gross amounts). prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the 'Change in prior underwriting year's provisions' gross column (194,595 thousand). Some LOB mappings are approximate where the report groups classes (e.g. 'Marine, aviation and transport' combined in the 'surpluses/(deficits)' disclosure) - these were mapped conservatively to standard LOBs. The report provides a gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims in GBP '000) which was used as a secondary consistency check. Net figures (e.g. the GBP 18.7m Russia/Ukraine IBNR) are reported in the notes but were not used as the principal gross prior-year movement source.
